xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5526: pan plan finalize reads a removed consent field (always no auto-start) and promises a deacon promotion recovery that does not exist

plan.title: pan plan finalize reads a removed consent field (always no auto-start) and promises a deacon promotion recovery that does not exist
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: readAutoSpawnOnFinalize in src/cli/commands/plan-finalize.ts reads the legacy v1 field autoSpawnOnFinalize, but every consent record written today is v2 (status granted|claimed|spent). So pan plan finalize and pan plan done always read false: the activity/TTS line says 'awaiting your approval' for auto-start plans, the deferred/skipped work-start report branches are unreachable, and the pending-promotion marker records autoSpawnRequested:false. The server still auto-starts because resolveAutoSpawnOnFinalize reads the v2 record when autoSpawn is omitted. Separately, when promotion fails finalize prints that 'the deacon will complete promotion automatically', but nothing reads pending-promotion.json since the Cut (PAN-3917) deleted its reconciler, and nothing announces the failure in the activity feed.
narratives.Proposal: The CLI stops sending autoSpawn (an explicit value makes the server write a new consent generation before its in-flight lease, a renewal race found by the plan critic); the server decides auto-start from the record. Delete readAutoSpawnOnFinalize; finalize awaits readAutoSpawnOnFinalizeFlagAsync only to word its output, and the pre-POST line says 'promoting with auto-start', never 'starting implementation'. Reword both promotion-failure messages to 'Promotion was not confirmed ... run pan plan done <id>' and emit an error activity entry plus TTS on that path. Keep writing the marker unchanged for PAN-5527. Document the manual recovery in features/planning.mdx and docs/XBRIEF.md, and add changelog.d/pan-5526.md. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5526.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No consumer for the pending-promotion marker in deacon-lite, dashboard boot or anywhere else (PAN-5527 owns it)
- No removal or shape change of the marker, PendingPromotionMarker or PENDING_PROMOTION_FILENAME
- No behavior change to the complete-planning route, resolveAutoSpawnOnFinalize or src/lib/planning/auto-spawn-consent.ts (one comment edit in planning-promotion.ts only)
- No renamed JSON output keys for pan plan finalize --json (promotionDeferred and promotionMarkerError stay)
- No change to promotePlanning retry counts, backoff or the 90 s timeout
- No separate wording for timeout versus definite failure
- The CLI must never send autoSpawn, and never claim, spend or rewrite the consent record

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the misleading promotion-failure message instead of adding a pending-promotion marker consumer
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the message change as the smaller fix and says to pick it unless a reader is trivial. A reader must re-run promotion (PRD gates, git commit and push, tracker transition) and coordinate the auto-start handoff, so it is not trivial; open issue PAN-5527 owns it.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep writing pending-promotion.json with its current shape
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5527 may build a consumer for it, and after this fix it records the correct autoSpawnRequested value. Removing it would pre-empt PAN-5527's choice.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the --json output keys promotionDeferred and promotionMarkerError
autoDecisions.rationale: Only human-readable text was wrong; renaming machine-readable keys is churn for any script consuming them.

autoDecisions.summary: Import readAutoSpawnOnFinalizeFlagAsync from auto-spawn-consent.js directly, not the spawn-planning-session.js re-export
autoDecisions.rationale: The consent module is the owner and is small; the re-export would load the whole planning spawn module into the CLI command.

autoDecisions.summary: The CLI never sends autoSpawn in the complete-planning body, deviating from the issue's suggested test that expects autoSpawn:true
autoDecisions.rationale: The plan critic showed, and code confirms, that an explicit value makes resolveAutoSpawnOnFinalize write a new consent generation before the route's in-flight lease, so a concurrent finalize can leave usable consent after work started. The omitted-key path only reads the record and already auto-starts today, so the issue's goal (honor consent) is met without the race.

autoDecisions.summary: Pre-POST activity/TTS for a consent plan says 'promoting with auto-start'; failure emits its own error activity and TTS
autoDecisions.rationale: The route already announces confirmed success and closes the planning pane right after promotion when auto-start applies, so the CLI cannot reliably announce success afterwards; it must not promise a start it cannot confirm.

metadata.sizeJustification: Four small items across two CLI files, one comment in planning-promotion.ts, three new unit tests and three doc files.

items.title: promotePlanning drops its autoSpawn parameter so neither CLI command sends autoSpawn

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item 1 exactly. In src/cli/commands/plan-finalize.ts change the promotePlanning signature to `promotePlanning(issueId: string, opts: { noPrd?: boolean; critic?: boolean } = {})`, delete the `...(autoSpawn ? { autoSpawn: true } : {}),` body line, update the call at the `const promotion = await promotePlanning(` site to `promotePlanning(issueId, { noPrd: options.prd === false, critic: critique.required })`, and reword the comment above PROMOTE_MAX_ATTEMPTS to say the route reads auto-start consent itself. In src/cli/commands/plan-done.ts import only promotePlanning, delete the readAutoSpawnOnFinalize comment and call, call `promotePlanning(issueId, { noPrd: options.prd === false })`, and rewrite header lines 8-11 with the PRD text. In tests/unit/cli/plan-finalize-promote-deferred.test.ts change `promotePlanning('PAN-4155', true)` to `promotePlanning('PAN-4155')` (3 places). In src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts edit only the comment above `if (bodyAutoSpawn === true)` as the PRD states. Add tests/unit/cli/plan-done-auto-spawn-consent.test.ts per PRD (temp OVERDECK_HOME, OVERDECK_DASHBOARD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3011, exitCli mocked, fetch stubbed HTTP 200 capturing init.body).

Change the consent branch of the pre-POST emitActivityEntry message to `${issueId} planning finalized — promoting with auto-start` and of emitActivityTts to `${issueId} planning finalized, promoting with auto-start`; leave the non-consent strings unchanged.
